fields.Name: T116 - Home App Card Click Navigation
fields.Description: Exercises onAppClick() → NavigationService.SwitchToApp(app.ID) from the app-card grid — a distinct navigation entry point from the application-switcher dropdown covered elsewhere.

InputDefinition.goal: You are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Go to the Home landing page (Home icon/logo or application switcher dropdown). Scroll to the 'My Applications' section and click one of the application cards (each shows an app icon, name, description, and a few nav-item chips). Verify that clicking the CARD navigates into that application — the workspace should switch to that app's view (a new/updated tab, the app's sections in the left nav, etc.), not just highlight the card. Success is that the app opens after clicking its card. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: Clicking an application card in the 'My Applications' grid navigates into that application (its content/sections load)
The destination reflects the app that was clicked (title/sections match the chosen card)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
